After Corona, China has been engulfed by another mysterious virus.
The outbreak of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is spreading in China. Due to this, a scene similar to Corona is being seen again in China. There is a crowd of patients in hospitals. The crematoriums are also full. https://t.co/kH0NsoJxCl
